dod_intent_evidence: A real DARPA Phase II SBIR exists (SBIR/STTR section: 'Antireflective optics for safe power beaming — Defense Advanced Research Projects Agency 2023 ($1,250,000)'), but it sits alongside a DOE SBIR ($1,150,000, solid-state lighting) and a California Energy Commission award ($999,940, concentrator photovoltaics) at a 4-10 person shop whose only commercial artifact is an architectural-lighting brand.
score_evidence: Three unrelated government R&D awards in three domains (DARPA power-beaming optics, DOE solid-state lighting, CEC concentrator PV) at 4-10 employees → the business model is winning research awards, not fielding a product
